art_direction: cinematic naturalistic ant empire; not cartoon; gameplay remains top-down/map readable

backdrops.render_rule: draw as cover-style environmental matte before map/tile layer; opacity 0.60-0.72; map cells and targets stay above it

tiles.rule: use as low-contrast texture; no giant repeated motifs

visual_rules: do not change world coordinates, target radii, hitboxes, pathfinding, AI or simulation
unit images are whole sprites; no CSS body-part animation
world must feel like a physical nest/forest, but interactive map remains readable
no flat green full-screen management-board look
no cartoon plant/bug glyphs as world objects
